name: Exposing A Lie
overview: Scripture reveals that lying and deceit are detestable to the Lord, who promises to destroy those who speak falsehoods and abhor the deceitful (Psalms 5:6). Truth is enduring and establishes righteousness, while lies are fleeting and lead to punishment, as a false witness will not go unpunished and those who speak lies shall perish (Proverbs 12:19; 19:5, 9). Faithfulness in testimony reflects godly character, in contrast to the destruction brought by falsehood (Proverbs 14:5). Ultimately, knowing and embracing the truth brings freedom, underscoring the power and necessity of truth in the believer’s life (John 8:32).
